# OPC Radar
> OPC Radar is a free opportunity radar for one-person companies (OPC), indie developers, designers and cross-border sellers. It collects AI tools, GitHub repos, new products, news, deals and ideas from public sources (Hacker News, GitHub, Hugging Face, DEV, Lobsters and a curated list), translates them into 10 languages and refreshes automatically. Currently 914 items.

- Site: https://siinxu.github.io/ai-opportunity-hub/
- Data (JSON): https://siinxu.github.io/ai-opportunity-hub/data/items.json
- Languages: zh-Hans, zh-Hant, en, ja, ko, ms, vi, fr, es, de (append ?lang=<code>)
- Publisher: Incidental AI (https://incidental.site/)
- Full list: https://siinxu.github.io/ai-opportunity-hub/llms-full.txt
- Updated: 2026-11-28T13:51:14Z

## Deals
- [GitHub Student Developer Package](https://education.github.com/pack) (Curated, 2026-10-12): The students are certified free of charge and receive dozens of development tools and clouds (domain names, cloud hosts, IDE, etc.).
- [Cloudflare Workers free of charge](https://workers.cloudflare.com/) (Curated, 2026-10-12): 100,000 requests per day for deployment of edge functions, stationary stations and KV, starting with independent developers.
- [Oracle Claude Allways Free](https://www.oracle.com/cloud/free/) (Curated, 2026-10-12): Permanent free ARM cloud hosts and storage lines suitable for running small services and reptiles.
- [Google Cloud Free Trial and Free Level](https://cloud.google.com/free) (Curated, 2026-10-12): The new users offered a trial grant and a long-term free layer of products.
- [AWS Free Tier](https://aws.amazon.com/free/) (Curated, 2026-10-12): The new account is free of charge and on a trial basis, covering calculations, storage, databases.
- [AWS Activate Entrepreneurship Support](https://aws.amazon.com/activate/) (Curated, 2026-10-12): Creative companies can apply for AWS cloud scale and technical support.
- [Google for Startups Cloud Programme](https://cloud.google.com/startup) (Curated, 2026-10-12): The original company applied for the Google Cloud level, which is higher for AI.
- [Microsoft for Startups](https://www.microsoft.com/en-us/startups) (Curated, 2026-10-12): Initial corporate support schemes, including the Azure scale and development tools.
- [Free-for.dev list of free services](https://free-for.dev/) (Curated, 2026-10-12): Developmentists provide free-of-charge community-based services, organized by category.
- [Jetbrains Education Free Authorization](https://www.jetbrains.com/community/education/) (Curated, 2026-10-12): Students and teachers have free access to the Jetbrains IDE.
- [Notion for Startups](https://www.notion.com/startups) (Curated, 2026-10-12): Eligible start-up teams can apply for a notion payment scheme discount.
- [Supabase Free Scheme](https://supabase.com/pricing) (Curated, 2026-10-12): Postgres + Authentication + Storage Free Layer, MVP backend sufficient.

## Ideas
- [YC Priorities for Startups](https://www.ycombinator.com/rfs) (Curated, 2026-10-12): Y Combinator published a list of entrepreneurial directions for investment, a business-winder.
- [Exploding Topics](https://explodingtopics.com/) (Curated, 2026-10-12): Tracking the rapidly growing search topics and identifying demand in advance.
- [Google Trends](https://trends.google.com/) (Curated, 2026-10-12): Free view of keyword heat and regional distribution, validation of ideas and cross-border selection.
- [Indie Hackers](https://www.indiehackers.com/) (Curated, 2026-10-12): Independent developers open up their communities of income and experience, with a large number of replicable cases.
- [Starter Story.](https://www.starterstory.com/) (Curated, 2026-10-12): Entrepreneur interview: Disassembly income, customer and toolbox in each case.
- [It's a daily report.](https://www.producthunt.com/) (Curated, 2026-10-12): New products are published daily to see what is being admired and what can be differentiated.
- [Hacker News Show HN](https://news.ycombinator.com/show) (Curated, 2026-10-12): Developer displays homemade project blocks, early products and real feedback places.
- [GitHub Trending](https://github.com/trending) (Curated, 2026-10-12): Open-source warehouses, with the fastest daily/weekly growth, find alternative, packaged projects.
- [Shopivy cross-border.](https://www.shopify.com/) (Curated, 2026-10-12): Independent station construction and collection, cross-border DTC start-up programmes.
- [Stripe Atlas](https://stripe.com/atlas) (Curated, 2026-10-12): Long-range registration of United States companies and the opening of collections, a common route for one company to sea.
- [a16z Consumer level AI 100](https://a16z.com/100-gen-ai-apps/) (Curated, 2026-10-12): a16z regularly publishes the most popular generated AI application list to see the real needs of users.
- [There's an AI for that](https://theresanaiforthat.com/) (Curated, 2026-10-12): AI Tool Catalogue and Daily New Up to Search for Empty Tracks.
- [Futurepedia](https://www.futurepedia.io/) (Curated, 2026-10-12): AI Tools are complete and classified, and a breakdown of market saturation is observed.
